title: Progress in Squeezed States of Electron Illumination
content: The quality of measurements using electron microscopes is fundamentally limited by the quality of electron beams. In recent times, there has been an effort to design innovative electron sources and beam wavefunction shaping capabilities. These include extremely narrow energy spread coherent single-electron guns [1,2], heralded electron sources [3], coulomb-correlated electron number states [4], crucial development in electron wavefunction shaping [5,6], and free-electron quantum optics [7]. Event-counting based measurements have emerged as an effective way to boost signal-noise-ratio (SNR) in dose-limited conditions [8,9].
